lead.headline: 433 wastewater permits broke discharge limits in most quarters for six years with no formal enforcement; Missouri 97, Ohio 68
lead.number: 433 individual permits over limits in 8+ of 12 quarters in both 2020-23 and 2023-26, none with a formal action; Missouri 97 and Ohio 68, about half of each state's chronic violators vs 18% elsewhere
lead.watch_out: State orders that never reach EPA's system look exactly like no enforcement; the data can't yet tell them apart.

The Environmental Law & Policy Center (ELPC) reviewed and analyzed publicly available enforcement data for EPA’s Region 7 office, which covers four Great Plains states: Iowa, Kansas, Missouri, and Nebraska. ELPC found shrinking funds, plummeting staff levels, declining enforcement metrics, and a corresponding rise in significant noncompliance with the Clean Water Act. Despite decades of bipartisan agreement on the value of environmental protection, the Republican-led Congress has consistently cut EPA’s budget over the past few years, and President Trump has proposed further budget cuts each year he’s been in office.
